snippet.title: Terra Foliata: Official Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
Explore the Valley of Mists, where lucid dreams create reality. Study people's dreams and determine their fate. Leave the hectic world for a while and return to yourself.

Developed by Teleolabs, Terra Foliata is coming to PC in 2025.
It's available to wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927540/Terra_Foliata
